content.statement: Crypto perpetual 的 maintenance margin、margin mode、liquidation price、bankruptcy price、partial liquidation、insurance fund takeover 和 ADL 风险必须按 venue/product/account mode 建模；不得把清算价等同普通止损，也不得把避免清算写成 CEK-TA 通用仓位建议。

content.citation_notes: Binance explains liquidation protocols, bankruptcy price and insurance fund takeover in volatile conditions.；Binance describes liquidation as a risk-control feature intended to prevent negative equity when leveraged positions suffer gaps.；Binance explains Mark Price and Price Index in futures and states that the Price Index mitigates manipulation risk by using multiple exchanges.；Bybit says mark price is used as a liquidation trigger and for unrealized PnL measurement in perpetual contracts.；Binance leverage and margin trading parameters provide venue/product-specific margin bracket context.；Bybit risk limit documentation supports position tier, maintenance margin and liquidation-risk context for perpetual/futures contracts.
